project_info.name: MuchoMoney8s
project_info.description: Production-ready esports management platform and Call of Duty 8s match generator featuring automated 4v4 team balancing, ELO tracking, match history, and performance analytics with Magma Red & Gold highlights.

font_family.heading: Chivo, Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif
font_family.mono_stats: Source Code Pro, JetBrains Mono, monospace

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight uppercase text-white

grid_modes.dashboard_top_kpis: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6

visual_enhancers.magma_card_glow: border border-[#FF2A3B]/30 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,42,59,0.12)] hover:border-[#FF2A3B]/60 transition-all duration-200
visual_enhancers.gold_card_glow: border border-[#FFB800]/30 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,184,0,0.12)] hover:border-[#FFB800]/60 transition-all duration-200
visual_enhancers.esports_badge: px-2.5 py-1 rounded-sm text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-widest border
visual_enhancers.gradient_accent_bar: h-1 w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FF2A3B] via-[#FFB800] to-[#FF2A3B]

Dashboard.description: Top KPIs (Total Players, Total Matches, Highest Elo, Most Active Player) + Recent Activity Feed + Quick Match Balancer CTA + Elo Distribution snippet.

Players.description: Player roster database with search, role filters, Elo badges, and detailed player profile dialog.

TeamBalancer.description: CORE FEATURE. Select 8 active players -> generate optimized 4v4 squads (Alpha vs Bravo) based on total ELO, partial/current ELO, and recent match trends. Displays balance score %, projected winner win-probability bar, and instantaneous team swap options.

Matches.description: Match creation/recording form + past match log history with date, map/mode tags, winning team, and MVP display.

Leaderboard.description: Sortable high-density esports table: Rank, Player Nickname, Current Elo, Peak Elo, Win Rate %, Wins/Losses, MVPs count, and CSV export functionality.

Statistics.description: Interactive data charts (Elo progression over time, Win rate breakdown, Most active players, Player performance radar/bar charts).

AdminPanel.description: Nickname-only access (no password). Allows adding/deleting players, manually adjusting Elo, resetting statistics, and injecting historical match records.

testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive element (button, input, tab, table row, select, modal trigger, toast) MUST include a explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the dark theme with black (#090A0F) background, dark gray surfaces (#10121A, #161924), and Magma Red (#FF2A3B) & Cyber Gold (#FFB800) accents.
Use JavaScript / React (.js and .jsx files) as set up in /app/frontend/src/.
Ensure the Team Balancer features an intuitive 8-player selection list, balanced 4v4 output showing precise Elo totals and balance percentage (e.g., '98.4% Match Balance').
Use localStorage to maintain persistence across page reloads for players, matches, and ELO history.
Do NOT use transparent dropdown menus or modal backgrounds. Use solid or blurred high-contrast dark backgrounds.
Include data-testid on all interactive buttons, forms, navigation tabs, cards, and table elements.
Utilize Sonner for dark-themed toast notifications upon saving matches or updating Elo.
